CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eldervale_private.quest_snapshot(uid uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'version',r.version,'data',r.data,'accepted',r.accepted,'completed',r.completed,'progress',r.progress)
   order by r.tutorial desc,r.chain,r.ord,r.updated_at),'[]'::jsonb)
 from (
  select q.id,coalesce(p.version,q.version) as version,coalesce(p.data,q.data) as data,q.updated_at,
   coalesce(q.data->>'chain','')='tutorial' as tutorial,coalesce(q.data->>'chain','') as chain,coalesce((q.data->>'order')::integer,0) as ord,
   l.live or (coalesce(q.data->>'chain','')='tutorial' and g.graduated) as accepted,
   (l.live and p.completed_at is not null) or (coalesce(q.data->>'chain','')='tutorial' and g.graduated) as completed,
   (case when l.live then coalesce(p.progress,'{}'::jsonb)-'_xp' else '{}'::jsonb end) as progress
  from eldervale_private.quest_definitions q
  cross join (select coalesce((select coalesce((s.game_flags->'tutorial'->>'done')::boolean,false) from public.player_saves s where s.user_id=uid),false) as graduated) g
  left join eldervale_private.player_quests p on p.quest_id=q.id and p.user_id=uid
  cross join lateral (select p.user_id is not null and not p.progress?'_reset' as live) l
  where (coalesce(q.data->>'chain','')<>'tutorial' and (coalesce((q.data->>'published')::boolean,false) or p.user_id is not null))
     or (q.data->>'chain'='tutorial' and (coalesce((q.data->>'published')::boolean,false) or l.live))
 ) r
$function$
